If SdEventHandlerTCP is configured: For every SubscribeEvent- group entry of this Event Handler and the SubscribeEventgroup entry reference an Endpoint Option, the following shall be done: • The relevant Routing Groups shall be identified by SdEventHandlerTcp. • The relevant TCP Socket Connection of this client shall be identified using the Address/Port of Endpoint Option (TCP) referenced in the SubscribeEventgroup entry and the SdServerServiceTcpRef, or shall be set up, if not existed before. • Check state of incoming TCP connection using SoAd_GetSoConMode. If mode is not SOAD_SOCON_ONLINE, answer using SubscribeEventgroupNack. Only if the client was not subscribed before receiving the aforementioned entry: – SoAd_EnableSpecificRouting with SdEventActivationRef and the Socket Connection. – SoAd_IfSpecificRoutingGroupTransmit with SdEventTriggeringRef and the Socket Connection. • Answer using SubscribeEventgroup entry.
